1931110118104.answer: I have a lot of friends I like to spend time with, and usually enjoy meeting new people. I am in constant contact with friends and often try to get them together to have fun and go places. Just thinking about getting something going gets me excited and motivated.

1931110119104.answer: I am a somewhat private person. I have very close friends I've known for years. I like to do things with them, but I also enjoy spending time alone – doing things I like to do or just relaxing. In social situations, especially new ones, I often prefer to listen and observe awhile before getting involved.

1941110218104.answer: At lunch I usually sit and talk with other people, and I belong to several clubs – because I like the social interaction. If given a choice, I prefer to do homework with others, and I often chat with my friends while I'm working.

1941110219104.answer: I have excellent powers of concentration and usually prefer to study alone. My interests are complex and intense - like I am - and I know a lot about the things that interest me. I enjoy having a meaningful conversation, but dislike superficial chit-chat.

1951110318104.answer: I have lots of energy, prefer to be involved in a variety of activities, and usually jump into new projects with enthusiasm. I often skip over directions and plunge into assignments. I'm very talkative – I think better when I talk things over with other people, and sometimes I dominate conversations.

1951110319104.answer: On the outside I may appear calm or distant, though I can get very enthusiastic about things that are important to me or when discussions become intense. Ordinarily I am fairly quiet unless I have something important to say – and when I do, it's usually well thought-out and people find it really interesting.

1961110418104.answer: When I meet someone new, I start a conversation with them.

1961110419104.answer: I wait for others to start conversations with me.

1971110518104.answer: I call up friends to see if they want to get together, and I enjoy parties, because I get to see lots of people.

1971110519104.answer: I would rather hang out with a close friend or two than socialize with a lot of people I don't know very well.

1981110618104.answer: I thrive on activity, and get bored and a little restless when nothing's going on.

1981110619104.answer: I need to spend some quiet time alone – to read, listen to music or just relax.

1991110718104.answer: I think through ideas by talking about them with others.

1991110719104.answer: I need to think things through before I'm ready to discuss them.

2001110818104.answer: I like to try different things and am often excited to jump into new experiences.

2001110819104.answer: I hang back and watch for awhile before getting involved in new situations.

2011110918104.answer: I usually like to share what's going on with my life and am interested to hear what others are doing as well.

2011110919104.answer: I am a fairly private person and prefer to focus on important events that affect me.

2021112820104.answer: I tend to be very responsible. I plan things in advance and like to follow those plans to save time and avoid surprises. I like it when decisions can be made quickly so things are settled and I can move on to what's next.

2021112821104.answer: I tend to be more casual and spontaneous. Rather than have things planned out, I prefer to keep my options open. Sometimes I even have trouble making up my mind. I often ask a lot of questions and delay my decisions until I have enough information.

2031112920104.answer: I really try to be productive and prefer to get my work done before playing or relaxing. I am usually very organized: my assignments are almost always neatly done and on time, or even early. I often feel a big sense of relief when my work is done and I can focus on something else.

2031112921104.answer: I often delay completing my work until the last minute. Organization is not really one of my strengths and I have been known to lose things. I usually start projects with lots of energy and good intention, but I don't always finish them so well.

2041113020104.answer: I am pretty time-conscious. I am rarely late and have a good sense of how long things will take. I have strong opinions about many things and usually don't hesitate to take charge and make things happen the way I think they should.

2041113021104.answer: I tend to forget about the time and can get sidetracked. This may cause me to be late for appointments or misjudge how long a job or task will take. I sometimes procrastinate with things like my homework and studying, but I usually manage to get everything done that I need to with a last-minute burst of energy.

2051113120104.answer: I like to plan ahead and am most comfortable when that plan is followed.

2051113121104.answer: I don't like to plan too much because I want to be free to respond to opportunities as they arise.

2061113220104.answer: I usually have no problem making a decision and typically feel settled once I have made a decision.

2061113221104.answer: I tend to think a lot about my decisions, even after making them.

2071113320104.answer: I like to know most of the details of an event or situation before I get involved.

2071113321104.answer: I like to figure things out along the way.

2081113420104.answer: I am almost always on-time and really dislike being late.

2081113421104.answer: Despite my best intentions, I am usually running a little late.

2091113520104.answer: I am fairly organized and usually know where everything is.

2091113521104.answer: I can be a little disorganized and sometimes have trouble finding things.

2101113620104.answer: I am willing to sacrifice being thorough or precise in order to finish things on time.

2101113621104.answer: I am willing to finish things late so I can be thorough or precise.

2111111022104.answer: I am a practical, realistic kind of person. I am pretty observant and have a good memory for details. When I talk to other people, I get right to the point, pay close attention to what they are saying and tend to stick with the subject at hand.

2111111023104.answer: I am a very creative person. I'm interested in anything new or unusual, but don't like to get caught up in all the details. I often am more curious about how things could be than how things are now. I like to figure out different ways to solve problems, but get bored pretty quickly once I've mastered something.

2121111122104.answer: In school I prefer, and do best at, subjects that deal with real and hands-on things rather than abstract ideas. I do better with questions such as, "Describe the things related to..." and "What are the features of...?". I like to work with solid facts and observations. I tend to see things for what they are, rather than try to make connections to other ideas.

2121111123104.answer: I like to think about ideas and possibilities. In school I prefer assignments that ask questions such as, "Why do you think this happened?" and "What would happen if...?". I also like to figure out "hidden" meanings and patterns in the information. I am especially curious about why people and things act the way they do.

2131111222104.answer: I like to work through projects step-by-step, completing one part of an assignment before moving on to the next. I prefer assignments with specific guidelines on what I need to do.

2131111223104.answer: I tend to work in bursts of energy, often jumping around to different parts of a project. More often than not, I will go where my instincts take me rather than follow a specific set of steps. I prefer assignments that encourage me to be creative and figure out what the final product will be.

2141111322104.answer: I'm pretty practical and realistic about most things.

2141111323104.answer: I have a good imagination and lots of creative energy.

2151111422104.answer: If something is already working well, I usually don’t like to change it.

2151111423104.answer: I like to tinker with things because I think there is always a better way.

2161111522104.answer: I work best when I can start at the beginning and progress in order through each step of a task.

2161111523104.answer: I tend to work in bursts of energy, often jumping around from one task to another.

2171111622104.answer: I prefer to learn practical things I can use in my everyday life.

2171111623104.answer: I enjoy thinking or talking about possibilities, even if they're not always practical.

2181111722104.answer: I tend to remember the facts and details about an event.

2181111723104.answer: I tend to remember an event from a general impression of what it was like and its overall meaning.

2191111822104.answer: I prefer to work on and master the skills I already have.

2191111823104.answer: I like to develop new skills often.

2201111924104.answer: I am a logical problem solver. I have a talent for analyzing situations objectively and calmly, and usually have no trouble putting my personal feelings aside when I'm making decisions. Competitive and assertive when I need to be, I rarely take things too personally.

2201111925104.answer: I'm a warm, helpful person who likes to do nice things for other people. A very good friend, I am sensitive to other people's needs and I go out of my way to make them feel comfortable.

2211112024104.answer: I can almost always be counted on to give my honest, truthful opinion. I am most impressed by achievement and accomplishment – my own and others' – and I set high standards for myself and others.

2211112025104.answer: I have strong convictions about lots of things and, while I strive to be honest and direct, I may avoid being entirely truthful in order to spare someone's feelings. Relationships are very important to me, and since I tend to take things to heart, I can easily be disappointed by others.

2221112124104.answer: I am quite independent. What I think about something is often more important to me than what others think about it. And I am more likely to do something because it's fair and makes sense to me. It doesn't matter if others may not like it.

2221112125104.answer: A natural helper, I tend to worry about other people's problems – that can make me feel sad. Although I can be competitive, I prefer to work cooperatively with people. I don't usually like to argue and am good at complimenting people when they do something I appreciate.

2231112224104.answer: I am most likely to be convinced by logical arguments.

2231112225104.answer: I am most likely to be convinced by how I feel, or how others feel, about an issue.

2241112324104.answer: I am objective and fair-minded and usually don't take things personally.

2241112325104.answer: I am sensitive and compassionate, and my feelings can get hurt pretty easily.

2251112424104.answer: I like to be judged by my accomplishments, and don't dwell on what others think of me personally.

2251112425104.answer: I like to feel appreciated and enjoy being helpful to others.

2261112524104.answer: I get satisfaction from remaining objective and coming up with logical solutions to problems.

2261112525104.answer: I get satisfaction from helping people with their problems.

2271112624104.answer: I can be counted on to tell people what I honestly believe, even if they don't like it.

2271112625104.answer: I sometimes say things more gently to avoid hurting someone's feelings.

2281112724104.answer: I often do something because I think it's the smart and sensible thing to do.

2281112725104.answer: I often do something because I feel strongly that it will make people happy.
